column2: on J81 the word is copied from the user command (cmd +0xf0, request 31), so the value is the user driver's. The A8X core is the A8 family: 0x00900004 first, 0x00a00004 second (inferred)

by the record layout: W+0x21c/+0x224 (pds_store, pds_store1) feed CDM_CONTEXT_PDS0/PDS1 (the firmware writes RGX 0x4b0 from the field at +60 of a block that starts at W+0x1e8, i.e. W+0x224); W+0x23c/+0x244 (terminate, the 0x00?00004 word) then match CDM_TERMINATE_PDS/PDS1 (0x4b8/0x4c0), whose writes were not located in the decode

2 units of the PDS data-size unit (Mesa asserts multiples of ROGUE_VDMCTRL_PDS_STATE0_PDS_DATA_SIZE_UNIT_SIZE): the program's data segment the PDS loads; the HALT reads none, but the data address must point at mapped memory
